title: The Challenges of Deploying an Algorithmic Pricing Tool: Evidence from Airbnb
near_miss_reason: Property-day Airbnb panel (Austin, LA, SF, Seattle) with property (propid) and calendar-day (time) FE, in which hosts start using Smart Pricing (SP) at host-specific dates after the SP launch (adopt_date varies; Figure 1 right) and switch between Base, Custom and Smart pricing day by day. Every reported reduced-form column violates the rules: Table 2 (reghdfe price/rev 1.custom#i.month [pw=iweight_CP], absorb(propid time)) and Table 3 (1.base#i.month 1.custom#i.month [pw=ipw], SP as the reference) use inverse-propensity weights from logit/mlogit on host covariates, interact the pricing-method indicators with calendar month (12 treatment-by-month coefficients), and Table 3 has a multi-valued (three-method) treatment that switches on and off daily. Figure 2 (xtreg smart_mean i.months_since_adopt i.ym, random effects by default) uses adopters' post-adoption months only. Appendix Tables A10-A11 use a single common post-launch date with propid, month and weekend FE. Not a 5c case (no time-varying controls; violations are IPW, treatment x month interactions and multi-valued treatment).
eligible_reason: No qualifying specification: IPW weights, treatment-by-calendar-month interactions and a multi-valued, switching pricing-method treatment in every reduced-form column; the remaining analysis is structural (MATLAB). Data are noised/de-identified and are not in the package (external Dropbox link).
design_notes: Stata reduced_form.do (Tables 1-3, Figures 1-2, Appendix A4-A11, Figures A1-A2), MATLAB structural demand/supply and counterfactuals, Python booking-probability model, R Table A9. Data file referenced: ../data/rf_analysis_anonymized.dta (4,574,430 property-day rows x 37 columns per README_data_variable.docx); variables include custom, smart, base, price_method, adopt_date (first checkin_date using SP), checkin_date (days relative to SP launch). Cluster propid. Figure A2 pre-trend plots add lead indicators F2-F6 for custom/SP adopters on top of the IPW treatment-by-month model.
